title: Planner: task hierarchy (nested tasks) in unified plans
summary: Hold: the cost rating assumes add-on licensing for unified-plan hierarchy even though the published entitlement table is expressly limited to premium plans. The briefing also says Learn does not describe hierarchy in unified plans, despite citing a beta Graph resource that does; its rollout and entitlement gaps should be stated more narrowly.
